Our Why

An experienced planner is always needful.
They should always be within reach.

Plan For Me Events was built to close the gap between needing professional planning guidance and actually having access to it — for every couple, at every stage of their journey. Whether couples planning a wedding, micro wedding, elopement, or proposal need focused guidance sessions to plan with confidence or full month-of coordination so they can simply show up and celebrate, I offer both — for every couple across Central Florida.

A New Kind of Support

You plan it.
I guide you.

Some couples take on their own wedding planning — and that's something beautiful. But without professional direction, the details can overwhelm even the most organized couple. My guidance sessions bring certified expertise directly to you, on your timeline.

  • Clarity on your wedding timeline and planning priorities
  • Confident vendor decisions with expert backing
  • An organized, actionable path forward
  • Professional insight — without the full commitment

About

My Story

Built for the Couples Who Deserve Better

Plan For Me Events was born from a simple observation: the couples who needed professional planning guidance most were often the ones who felt it wasn't an option for them.

As a certified wedding and event planner, I've worked alongside couples through every kind of celebration. And across every single one, the difference between a stressful journey and a joyful one almost always came down to having the right guidance at the right time.

So I created guidance sessions — so any couple, planning any kind of celebration, can have a certified planner in their corner. No long-term contract. No day-of requirement. Just expertise when you need it most.

Book a Session

E

Certified expertise you can feel — from your first guidance session to your wedding day.

The Mission

A planner's mind should be a resource — not a luxury.

That's the gap I built Plan For Me Events to close. Whether you're planning a 200-person wedding or eloping with just the two of you — you deserve someone truly experienced in your corner.
